svg.title: Classifying Periodic Variable Stars. Classifying RR Lyrae, Cepheids, long-period variables, and eclipsing binaries using Gaia DR3 photometry and sequence models.
svg.desc: A Gaia DR3 photometry project that classifies RR Lyrae, Cepheids, long-period variables, and eclipsing binaries. The notebook uses Pandas and NumPy for data preparation, scikit-learn for preprocessing and evaluation, and TensorFlow/Keras sequence models, with plots from Matplotlib and Seaborn. Technologies: Python, Gaia DR3, scikit-learn, TensorFlow. Open repository.

g.aria-label: variables, and eclipsing binaries using Gaia DR3
